fix(grok): stop ambiguous expiry recovery

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-18
  description: |-
    Classify Grok expiry cancellation through the exact cancellation outcome before closing the retained session. Requested, unknown, unsupported, and adapter-error outcomes now remain retained and return an unknown observation for controller Attention; only confirmed or already-terminal cancellation may proceed to close and exact recovery.
    
    Add fake-runtime coverage proving a provider `unknown` cancellation status does not close or resume the exact session.
